title: Food establishments; use of latex gloves prohibited.
bodyText: The use of latex gloves by personnel in a food establishment permitted under title 11, chapter 50 of the Hawaii administrative rules, shall be prohibited.
bodyHtml: [§328-12.4]  Food establishments; use of latex gloves prohibited.  The use of latex gloves by personnel in a food establishment permitted under title 11, chapter 50 of the Hawaii administrative rules, shall be prohibited. [L 2016, c 180, §4]
